decisions.reason: Selecting Inter for article body text does not change the requirement to break up long passages with images, blurbs, or quotes.
The typeface approval does not cancel or change the existing article-ending standard, Fun Fact image method, or future word-count method.
The accepted article body typeface does not affect author names, author photographs, their presentation, or their source.
Changing the article body typeface does not alter the requirement that the table of contents use page numbers from the finalized layout.
The source approves a body-text typeface but does not modify the broader polished, modern, brand-aligned style or the existing red-color rule.
Article body typography is independent of whether advertisement assets render clearly.
Although the preceding proposal mentions that Inter will look better in the flipbook, the acceptance does not change the digital deliverable or its required two-page-spread behavior.
The body-typeface selection does not add, remove, or otherwise change any required article or tribute-page content.
The source does not change the flat-plan basis, article placement rules, tribute placement, or editorial ordering.
Selecting Inter for body text does not modify the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The source approves a typography choice and does not alter the digital launch target or deadline.
